# LSR-2 engineering budget (generated by calc/lsr2_sizing.py)

Wind: tracking 60 km/h (170 Pa), survival parked 100 km/h (473 Pa). Motor NEMA23 2.8 N·m holding, 70% usable at speed; worm efficiency 45%. Gearbox data are generic catalogue values: **verify with your supplier**.

## Torque per payload (worst axis) and gearbox choice

| Payload | Track torque (N·m) | Survival torque (N·m) | NMRV030 | NMRV040 | NMRV050 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms | 11.9 | 31.0 | ✅ 17/33 | ✅ 31/62 | ✅ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.2 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 15.4 | 40.1 | ❌ 17/33 | ✅ 31/62 | ✅ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.2 m, solid | 30.1 | 79.3 | ❌ 17/33 | ❌ 31/62 | ✅ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.8 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 51.2 | 134.3 | ❌ 17/33 | ❌ 31/62 | ❌ 55/110 |
| Dish 1.8 m, solid | 100.9 | 267.1 | ❌ 17/33 | ❌ 31/62 | ❌ 55/110 |

Cell = ✅/❌ and "available tracking torque / standstill holding torque" (N·m). ✅ needs both, plus the AZ bearing check below.

## AZ overturning moment (survival wind)

EL axis 300 mm above the upper AZ bearing; external 6206 pair, 120 mm apart, plus 51206 thrust bearing.

| Payload | Overturning (N·m) | Gearbox alone allows (NMRV030) | s0 radial pair | s0 thrust |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms | 60 | 38 | 16.1 | 291 |
| Dish 1.2 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 112 | 38 | 8.6 | 255 |
| Dish 1.2 m, solid | 224 | 38 | 4.3 | 204 |
| Dish 1.8 m, mesh (solidity 0.5) | 253 | 38 | 3.8 | 177 |
| Dish 1.8 m, solid | 505 | 38 | 1.9 | 124 |

**Finding:** the worm gearbox output bearings cannot carry the overturning moment of any payload above. LSR-2 therefore puts the AZ shaft in its own radial bearing pair plus the thrust bearing (cast housing), and the gearbox only transmits torque through the keyed shaft. This differs from the Mk5 load path.

## Structural checks of the cast parts (survival wind)

Payload Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms, 100 km/h, parked. Geometry from cad/lsr2/cast_parts.py. A356-T6 sand allowable 80 MPa and E 72 GPa (**VERIFY** with the foundry). U-bolts: 8 kN preload per M8 U-bolt (2 legs), friction mu 0.2, class A4-80 or 8.8 (**VERIFY**). Rib model: the moment axis runs through two of the four ribs (couple over the rib radius), the lower-bearing shear bends the ribs fixed-guided in their strong plane. Arm model: cantilever from the mast tangent point to the U-bolt leg, worst case for the smallest mast. Clamp preload bending of the arms is not covered: proof-load the first casting (**VERIFY**).
EL head (phase 6b): one-sided boom along the EL axis, Yagi payload, survival wind. Weight and wind of the two Yagis (stations at 0.45, 0.95 m from the socket mouth), the tube and the socket give a bending moment at the outer of the two 6206 bearings (62 mm apart, in the el_bearing_housing); wind and weight are combined at 90 deg (conservative). The Ø14 shaft section in the gearbox hub then only transmits torque; its radial load follows from 0.04 mm coaxiality plus the slope of the Ø30 section (cantilever stub model, **VERIFY**), limit 0.2 fr2. Shaft yield 200 MPa (1.4404, **VERIFY**), von Mises with bending and torsion on the 30 mm section; keyway stress concentration, the keyed Ø14 section torsion (SF about 2), fatigue and the el_bracket joint tilt are not covered: proof-load the first unit (**VERIFY**). Housing bolts: moment over a PCD65 couple, thread strength in the NMRV face 10 kN per M6 (**VERIFY**). Tube: 6063-T6, 170 MPa (**VERIFY**).

**Finding:** with the boom one-sided along the EL axis, the antenna moment is far beyond what the gearbox hub carries, so the EL axis needs a bearing pair exactly like AZ (the Ø14 gearbox section stays torque-only).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Motion

12°/s at the output = 160 rpm at the motor, 1067 steps/s at 400 microsteps/rev (DM542 as on SARCTrac Mk5, SARCNET; well inside RP2040 PIO and DM542 limits).

## Mk5 options decided by the checks

- **M14 threaded rod as EL shaft** (Mk5): von Mises 1015 MPa at the outer bearing vs 450 MPa (M14 A2-70 threaded rod), SF 0.4 (needed 2) ❌ keep the turned Ø30 shaft.
- **M14 rod as AZ gearbox section** (torque only, standstill torque): von Mises 166 MPa, SF 2.7; it passes as a stub but the AZ shaft must stay one Ø30 piece (bearing seats, Ø16 cable bore), so no saving.
- **M30x56x3 shims under the 51206**: circlip + 2 washers = 7.5 mm of the 23.0 mm to the mast clamp ✅ (1 mm spare).

## Recommendation

- Crossed Yagi pair 145/435, ~2 m booms: **NMRV030**
- Dish 1.2 m, mesh (solidity 0.5): **NMRV040**
- Dish 1.2 m, solid: **NMRV050**
- Dish 1.8 m, mesh (solidity 0.5): **none of the NMRV sizes**: use a slewing drive or reduce the payload
- Dish 1.8 m, solid: **none of the NMRV sizes**: use a slewing drive or reduce the payload
